problem:
Given that the minor of ${a}_{22}$ is $-70$, find all the possible values of $k$ in the matrix

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}2k & -8 & 6 \\ 0 & 5 & -7 \\ 11 & 9 & k+3\end{aligned}].
$$
worked_solution:
First, we remove the second row and second column:

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}2k & ∗ & 6 \\ ∗ & 5 & ∗ \\ 11 & ∗ & k+3\end{aligned}]
$$

The minor of ${a}_{22}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{det}[\begin{aligned}2k & 6 \\ 11 & k+3\end{aligned}] & =|\begin{aligned}2k & 6 \\ 11 & k+3\end{aligned}| \\  & =2k\cdot (k+3)-11\cdot 6 \\  & =2{k}^{2}+6k-66.\end{aligned}
$$

We're told that the minor of ${a}_{22}$ is $-70$, so we must have:

$$
\begin{aligned}2{k}^{2}+6k-66 & =-70 \\ 2{k}^{2}+6k+4 & =0 \\ {k}^{2}+3k+2 & =0 \\ (k+1)(k+2) & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solutions are $k=-1$ and $k=-2.$
